narr: An inverted trough moving westward near the Arizona/New Mexico border aided in thunderstorm development during the afternoon of the 27th across far eastern Arizona. Thunderstorms progressed toward the west before reaching southern Gila County late in the afternoon. Deep monsoonal moisture, with PWATs in excess of 1.70, resulted in thunderstorms being efficient rainfall producers. In the Globe area, rainfall amounts upwards of 1.70 in an hour were reported. Heavy rainfall in the area led to isolated flash flooding near the San Carlos Apache Indian Reservation line along with several reports of minor flooding in the Globe area. No damage or injuries were reported.
ev: Videos on social media showed high flow in a wash near the San Carlos Apache Indian Reservation line between Globe and San Carlos, making low water crossings through the wash impassable. Further downstream, a 5 ft rise was recorded in Gilson Wash. No damage or injuries were reported.
